verses.html: Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave. I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
verses.text: Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave. I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
verses.title: Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.
verses.titleHtml: Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.

verses.html: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.text: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

verses.html: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

verses.html: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.text: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

verses.html: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.text: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.html: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.text: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

verses.html: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
